description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Awoken Thief], [Damage Cap +10000], [Thief Instant Cast] and [Luminescence] to the user

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Awoken Thief
description.text: Thief abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Thief abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Thief Instant Cast
description.text: Instant cast speed for Thief abilities

description.name: Luminescence
description.text: Grants [Attach Wind] after using two Thief abilities
